api: xml_parser_create_ns(?string $encoding = null, string $separator = ":"): XMLParser; xml_parse(XMLParser $parser, string $data, bool $is_final = false): int
runtime: PHP 8.5.12 CLI (source build, --disable-all --with-libxml --enable-xml) with source-built libxml2 2.15.4
input: In-memory bytes: the harness reads the control file and passes its bytes to xml_parse() in one call with is_final=true on a parser from xml_parser_create_ns(); ext/xml feeds them to the libxml2 push parser (xmlCreatePushParserCtxt, xmlParseChunk). No other parser or library sees the bytes.
coverage: Clang/LLVM source coverage in PHP 8.5.12 ext/xml (xml.c and compat.c, the expat-compatible SAX layer) and ext/libxml plus source-built libxml2 2.15.4 during valid namespace-aware XML replay; the summary is built in PHP event handlers called from compat.c while xml_parse runs
observable_limits: Event-handler summary from ext/xml with case folding off (ext/xml folds case by default, and then upper-cases the whole expanded name, namespace URI included) and the separator "\x01" (not an RFC 3986 URI character and not an XML 1.0 Char, so it cannot occur in a well-formed XML 1.0 namespace or local name; ext/xml only uses the first separator byte). Character data and CDATA share the character data handler, so CDATA boundaries are not distinguished; text runs are flushed at element starts/ends, PIs and comments as in the expat oracle. ext/xml has no comment handler: comments reach the default handler as "<!--...-->" and only mark a text boundary. Any other default-handler data (an unexpanded user-defined entity reference, which needs a DTD) makes the harness fail rather than summarize it. ext/xml sets XML_PARSE_OLDSAX|XML_PARSE_NOENT on the libxml2 push parser and transcodes output to UTF-8. The controls are fed in one final xml_parse chunk; chunked feeding, the XML declaration (not reported) and xml_parse_into_struct are not exercised.
